verses.en: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado é aquele que considera o pobre; o Senhor o livrará no dia do mal.
verses.en_web: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> Happy is the man who gives thought to the poor; the Lord will be his saviour in the time of trouble.

verses.en: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.pt: O Senhor o guardará, e o conservará em vida; será abençoado na terra; tu, Senhor não o entregarás à vontade dos seus inimigos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will keep him safe, and give him life; the Lord will let him be a blessing on the earth, and will not give him into the hand of his haters.

verses.en: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
verses.pt: O Senhor o sustentará no leito da enfermidade; tu lhe amaciarás a cama na sua doença.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will be his support on his bed of pain: by you will all his grief be turned to strength.

verses.en: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
verses.pt: Disse eu da minha parte: Senhor, compadece-te de mim, sara a minha alma, pois pequei contra ti.
verses.en_web: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
verses.en_bbe: I said, Lord, have mercy on me; make my soul well, because my faith is in you.

verses.en: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.pt: Os meus inimigos falam mal de mim, dizendo: Quando morrerá ele, e perecerá o seu nome?
verses.en_web: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
verses.en_bbe: My haters say evil against me, When will he be dead, and his name come to an end?

verses.en: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
verses.pt: E, se algum deles vem ver-me, diz falsidades; no seu coração amontoa a maldade; e quando ele sai, é disso que fala.
verses.en_web: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
verses.en_bbe: If one comes to see me, deceit is in his heart; he keeps a store of evil, which he makes public in every place.

verses.en: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.pt: Todos os que me odeiam cochicham entre si contra mim; contra mim maquinam o mal, dizendo:
verses.en_web: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
verses.en_bbe: All my haters are talking secretly together against me; they are designing my downfall.

verses.en: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
verses.pt: Alguma coisa ruim se lhe apega; e agora que está deitado, não se levantará mais.
verses.en_web: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
verses.en_bbe: They say, He has an evil disease, which will not let him go: and now that he is down he will not get up again.

verses.en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.pt: Até o meu próprio amigo íntimo em quem eu tanto confiava, e que comia do meu pão, levantou contra mim o seu calcanhar.
verses.en_web: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.en_bbe: Even my dearest friend, in whom I had faith, who took bread with me, is turned against me.

verses.en: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.pt: Mas tu, Senhor, compadece-te de mim e levanta-me, para que eu lhes retribua.
verses.en_web: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
verses.en_bbe: But you, O Lord, have mercy on me, lifting me up, so that I may give them their punishment.

verses.en: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.pt: Por isso conheço eu que te deleitas em mim, por não triunfar de mim o meu inimigo
verses.en_web: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
verses.en_bbe: By this I see that you have pleasure in me, because my hater does not overcome me.

verses.en: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
verses.pt: Quanto a mim, tu me sustentas na minha integridade, e me colocas diante da tua face para sempre.
verses.en_web: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
verses.en_bbe: And as for me, you are my support in my righteousness, giving me a place before your face for ever.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.pt: Bendito seja o Senhor Deus de Israel de eternidade a eternidade. Amém e amém.
verses.en_web: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord God of Israel be praised, through eternal days and for ever. So be it. So be it.
